svg.title: RAG system architecture
svg.desc: Browser calls an API gateway, which forwards to an internal backend. The backend query path runs retrieval, cite-or-refuse, a streamed LLM call, and tracing, backed by SQLite. An ingestion worker loads EDGAR filings into SQLite, and an eval harness runs golden questions through the same query path.

g.text: Allowlist, admin token, CORS, rate limit, shedding
Golden Qs → judge → diff vs baseline
